facts.fact: JJ 向 Arthur 承诺今晚把 Emily 带去，却觉得她比平时更失常，怕她当场说出或做出什么。
facts.anchor: He had promised Arthur he would bring Emily tonight but she seemed unhinged, even more so than usual.

facts.fact: Emily 那句“如果那是你的真名”让 JJ 血液凝固，他确认她知道得比她透露的多。
facts.anchor: If that is your real name. The words had made his blood freeze in his veins.

facts.fact: JJ 靠母亲在社区成人社保的工作，翻她的文件挑出独居、脆弱、行将失智的老人下手。
facts.anchor: His mother worked in the community in adult social care. This allowed him to identify the isolated and vulnerable.

facts.fact: 他坐了十八个月牢，母亲羞于出庭，只探望过他一次。
facts.anchor: Served eighteen months inside. His own mum was too ashamed to attend his trial.

facts.fact: 出狱后他改名 Jake Jeffreyes，在利兹入学，向行政人员编造躲避家暴父亲的故事。
facts.anchor: Accepted on a course in Leeds, he adopted the name Jake Jeffreyes.

facts.fact: Arthur 和 Charlie 要他把 Emily 交给他们，而他怕她揭穿自己。
facts.anchor: They wanted him to deliver Emily to them.

facts.fact: 他认定她醉到去不了反而更好，于是主动给她续酒。
facts.anchor: He picked up the bottle of wine and refilled her glass.

facts.fact: 他答八点十分出发，心里算着她还有三个多小时可以喝到不省人事。
facts.anchor: It would give her more than three hours to drink herself into oblivion.
